subject: Re: M-Theory numerics — status: small scans done, precision risk
body:
Status:

- Loader flow shipped 04-22. The SUGRA_Colab notebook now loads the m_theory module from our internal mirror or from an uploaded m_theory.zip archive with the reset_package path working — Farah's demo went smoothly.
- Small scans reproduce the known critical-point catalogue: 41/41 previously published stationary points recovered, residuals below 1e-9.

Risk for the big scan: float32 on the accelerators loses us stationary points with shallow basins — on the small runs we miss ~8% of points unless we do a float64 polish pass on CPU afterwards. That polish adds roughly 1.5 days of wall-clock to the June scan. I've budgeted it into the schedule, but it means the 256-chip week has zero slack. If the scan slips past 06-26 we report partial results at the OKR lock.

Yara
